Context: 13. During training in lndia.-

## 13. During training in lndia.-  
- (i) When DA not drawn.Admissible at the rates applicable to the headquarters station or training station, whichever is more
- favourable.
- (ii) When DA drawn.Admissible at the rates applicable to head quarters only, even when no DA is drawn for the period beyond 180 days. - Para. 6.5.
